items.notes: Language-neutral entry point. Canonical is self-referencing absolute; the ES and EN home are reciprocal alternates. x-default is the Spanish home and is the only neutral entry point of the site.

Language-neutral entry point. Canonical is self-referencing absolute; the ES and EN home are reciprocal alternates. x-default is the Spanish home and is the only neutral entry point of the site. The served /en document also emits the same x-default link (observed); the dataset assigns x-default to the ES home row only because both declarations point at the same Spanish home and there is one neutral entry point.

Product detail is per-entity. ES canonical is self-referencing when the product is active. The EN URL may only declare a canonical when the product has complete English text; an ES-only product must not advertise an EN alternate. Observed on 2026-11-02: /tienda/<slug> declares only the "es" alternate for an ES-only product, and "es"+"en" for a translated product.

Private cart: noindex, no canonical and no hreflang in the served response. Observed on 2026-11-02: the served shell carries X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow" and no canonical or hreflang link.
